title: OneDrive on the web: Copilot creates a presentation from a Word file
summary: Hold for two overstatements: requiring a Copilot licence does not establish that unlicensed users cannot see the option, and Microsoft does document general protections for sensitivity-labelled content used by Copilot. The roadmap facts and licence-assignment controls check out; the OneDrive action's save location and label inheritance remain unconfirmed.
